notes: v655 - DELAYED prices, on pending orders only. In the Pending tab there is a new 'Check delayed prices' button. It fetches a price for each pending order, typically 15-20 minutes behind the market, and tells you whether today looks like filling your limit - using the day's LOW, because that is what actually fills a limit buy, not the last traded price. IT IS DISPLAY ONLY, and the panel says so every time. Nothing in this app buys, sells, scans or grades on a delayed price. Everything the rules act on is still end-of-day: the signals, the evidence grading, the daily picks and the order fills all read completed sessions, and the 5% dip entry means 5% below the last CLOSE. That is deliberate - a near-live price the rules cannot act on invites acting anyway, which would mean leaving the tested strategy behind while the app still looked like it was backing you. On a pending order it answers a question about a decision you already made, which is the one place it helps without inviting a rule-free trade. Requires the server to have delayed quotes configured; if it does not, the panel says so plainly. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
